name: Past Perfect Continuous
summaryPt: Ação contínua que aconteceu antes de outra no passado, com ênfase na duração.

meaningUses.pt: Duração de uma ação antes de outra no passado
meaningUses.en: I had been working for hours when she called.
meaningUses.enPt: Eu estava trabalhando há horas quando ela ligou.

meaningUses.pt: Causa de um estado no passado
meaningUses.en: She was tired because she had been studying all night.
meaningUses.enPt: Ela estava cansada porque tinha estudado a noite toda.

formation.pattern: I had been working — she had been working

examples.en: I had been working for hours.

examples.pt: Você estava esperando há muito tempo?

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + had. No, + pronome + hadn't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.

examples.en: A: Had you been waiting? B: Yes, I had.
examples.pt: A: Você estava esperando? B: Sim.

subjectAgreement.pt: A mesma forma (had been) para todas as pessoas.
subjectAgreement.example: I had been working. She had been working. They had been working.

pronunciation.pt: had been em fala rápida → /həd bɪn/.

commonErrors.right: I had been working for hours.

commonErrors.pt: Usar past perfect simples sem ênfase na duração
commonErrors.wrong: I had worked for hours when she called.
commonErrors.right: I had been working for hours when she called. (ênfase na duração)

contrast.pt: Past perfect = resultado. Past perfect continuous = duração/processo antes de outra ação.
contrast.en: I had written the report. (pronto) — I had been writing the report. (processo)
contrast.enPt: Eu tinha escrito o relatório. — Eu estava escrevendo o relatório.
